title: Searching for old photographs of the early bands
summary: Russell asks about old photographs; Robertson has none from way back and kept only a framed one.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: Hunting for old band photographs and scrapbooks

blocks.x: Well I was going to ask, well I think of it, if you have any old photographs of, oh, 30 or 40 years ago or longer back. So many real old bands, you know, the old time, like the old Excelsior band or anything of that kind. No, I don't have any other. You remember a boy. Now most people didn't bother to save the pictures.

I just wondered if you had it right there. No, we didn't have none of them way back. I had some when I was over the river, whatever, I guess, by moving around, you know, tripping around a little. Just like these, yeah, this B-Law, this is what I had to say. The B-Law's about, the best one I had is up in that thing there. Didn't have this or that, but I don't know. Yeah, I had it in a, why I had it so long, because I had it in a, in a bag, and a couple of years ago I put it up there in that frame. So I keep one of them, but I don't usually do with them, you know.
